caption: The drawing features a single object situated centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object is a three-legged tool with a metal frame and a wooden handle. The metal part forms a triangular shape with three legs, each leg ending in a small outward-facing hook at the bottom. The metal appears dark gray, and shading is used to give it dimension. Extending perpendicularly from one side of the triangle is a cylindrical wooden handle, rendered with visible wood grain texture and depicted in shades of brown and gray. The handle is fitted securely into the metal frame. The drawing is done in a realistic style with careful attention to shading and texture. In the bottom left corner, there is a handwritten signature in faint gray pencil.
title: Trivet
